q: Who is the radio host in every GTA game?
a: Lazlow Jones, playing a version of himself, has appeared in every main-line GTA from GTA III on, by his own account. His talk roles include Chatterbox FM (GTA III), Entertaining America on WCTR (San Andreas), Integrity 2.0 (GTA IV) and Chattersphere on WCTR (GTA V).
No. Asked in 2025, Lazlow said he doubted it, and he is not in the game's credits. He left Rockstar in 2020 and now works with Dan Houser at Absurd Ventures.

PC Gamer put his departure in April 2020, a month after Dan Houser left; VGC reported it on August 14, 2020, from his LinkedIn. He has said his sister's terminal cancer diagnosis made him reevaluate his priorities.

q: Who voices Chakra Attack in GTA 5?
a: J.B. Smoove voices Dr. Ray De Angelo Harris on WCTR's Chakra Attack, with Annie Lederman as producer Cheryl Fawkes. Smoove told PC Gamer in 2018 that the show was scripted but he was given room to have fun.

q: What talk radio shows are in GTA San Andreas?
a: WCTR carries WCTR News, The Tight End Zone, The Wild Traveler, Entertaining America, Gardening with Maurice, I Say/You Say, Lonely Hearts and Area 53. Wil Wheaton voices news reporter Richard Burns.

q: Were the GTA IV WKTT callers real people?
a: Some were. In July 2007 Rockstar opened WKTTRadio.com with a New York number for fan messages, and some of those calls ended up on The Richard Bastion Show.

q: Why does Blaine County Radio cut out in GTA 5?
a: Blaine County Radio only plays inside Blaine County, and WCTR only in Los Santos County. Cross the county line and the radio skips to the next station.

q: Does GTA Chinatown Wars have talk radio?
a: No. Chinatown Wars' stations are all instrumental, with no voices of any kind.
